answer: Because the trellis stake is held until the raven settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the relic audit lists each exposure. A farm running 51 keys thus pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation low-cost. An attester must stake 23% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
